It commenced on 21 September 2023 and concluded with the [[2024 Indian Super League final|ISL Cup final]] on 4 May 2024.{{cite web|url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/football/indian-football/isl-2023-24-schedule-indian-super-league-full-list-matches-teams-dates-venue-kerala-blasters-mohun-bagan-east-bengal/article67277382.ece |publisher=Indian Super League}} [[Mumbai City FC|Mumbai City]] were the defending champions whilst [[Mohun Bagan Super Giant|Mohun Bagan]] were the defending cup winners.{{cite web|date=2023-02-11 |title=Mumbai City FC wins the ISL 2022-23 League Winners Shield after a 5-3 win over FC Goa |url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/football/isl/mumbai-city-fc-wins-isl-indian-super-league-winners-shield-after-beating-fc-goa-mcfc-v-fcg-news/article66496830.ece |access-date=2023-09-13 |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/sports/football/atk-mohun-bagan-beat-bengaluru-fc-on-penalties-to-lift-maiden-indian-super-league-title-101679157855035.html |access-date=2023-09-13 |website=Hindustan Times |language=en}} Mohun Bagan became champions by winning their first ISL shield and sixth Indian title overall by topping the league table with a record 48 points.{{Cite web |url=https://www.indiansuperleague.com/features/mohun-bagan-sg-are-isl-champions-the-glory-the-records-and-the-heroes |title=Mohun Bagan SG are ISL champions: The glory, the records and the heroes |date=17 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240416233642/https://www.indiansuperleague.com/features/mohun-bagan-sg-are-isl-champions-the-glory-the-records-and-the-heroes |archive-date=16 April 2024 |url-status=live |publisher=Indian Super League}} Mumbai City won their second ISL Cup, defeating Mohun Bagan 3–1 in the [[2024 Indian Super League final|final]]. Also Mumbai City became the first club to win to ISL Cup through winning all knockout matches. ==Changes from last season== *This was the first season where the promoted [[I-League]] winner competed, thereby increasing the number of participating teams to 12. [[Punjab FC]] was promoted to the Indian Super League by winning the [[2022–23 I-League]].{{cite web|first=Sayantan |last=Guha |url=https://www.sportskeeda.com/indian-football/news-roundglass-punjab-fc-secure-premier-1-license-play-isl-2023-24-likely-jln-stadium-delhi |title=RoundGlass Punjab FC secure Premier 1 License; to ISL Cup playoffs}} The ISL Cup/ISL Play-offs is a knockout tournament held after the regular league season. * '''Format:''' ** Top six teams from the league qualify for the play-offs. ** The top two teams advance directly to the two-legged semi-finals. ** Teams ranked 3rd to 6th play a single-legged knockout round, hosted by the higher-ranked team. * '''Progression:''' ** Winners of the knockout stage join the top two teams in the semi-finals. ** Semi-finals are played over two legs to determine the finalists. ** The tournament culminates in a single-leg final hosted by the higher-ranked
